sentences.text: A draft genome sequence of Enterocloster clostridioformis strain EC-BI was reported from the faeces of a healthy two-week-old Jersey calf, with a 5.52 megabase genome.
A cross-sectional study of 107 participants reported Enterocloster clostridioformis as one of two species-level features enriched in patients with metastatic colorectal cancer.
A study of the rectal bacteriome in untreated early HIV infection reported that Enterocloster clostridioformis was significantly depleted among people with HIV.

In a randomised placebo-controlled trial of a Bifidobacterium supplement in 104 patients with advanced gastrointestinal cancer, Enterocloster clostridioformis was among pathobionts depleted after supplementation.

In obese mice, supplementation with a plant extract was accompanied by enrichment of Enterocloster clostridioformis, and oral administration of that species alone reproduced beneficial metabolic phenotypes.
